summary: Frontend-only regression on unified auth surfaces (AuthShell) across /auth/login, /auth/register, /reset-password, /auth/secure-account, /auth/accept-invite at 1920x1080, 768x1024 and 390x844 in both light and dark. All 30 (5 screens × 3 viewports × 2 themes) combinations render the shared frame with AuthHeaderControls (auth-lang-trigger + auth-lang-current='EN' + theme-toggle-button), a TrustStrip containing '9 blockchains', no horizontal overflow, no raw i18n keys, no user-visible console errors, and dark bg = rgb(11,11,15) when data-theme='dark'. Language menu (auth-lang-menu) exposes all 6 options en/pt/fr/es/de/nl with EN pre-selected (Mui-selected), Escape closes it, PT switch flips heading to 'Conecte-se' on login and 'Defina a nova senha' on reset-password, persists in localStorage.lang across reload and across navigation to /auth/register and /reset-password. Theme toggle aria-label translates ('Switch to dark mode' → 'Mudar para o modo escuro' → 'Mudar para o modo claro'). Reset-password shows title 'Set a new password', purpose line mentioning qa@example.com, testids reset-password-new / reset-password-confirm / reset-password-submit; submit is disabled until both fields have content and mismatch renders 'Passwords don't match'. Secure-account invalid (and no-token) renders secure-account-card[data-status='invalid'], secure-account-title 'Link expired or already used', secure-account-message, and secure-account-login-btn 'Go to login' that navigates to /auth/login (no infinite spinner). Accept-invite invalid renders accept-invite-error, title 'Invite unavailable' and accept-invite-login-btn 'Go to login' → /auth/login. Login password step exposes password-input, signin-submit-btn and 'Keep me signed in for 7 days'; 'Forgot your password?' opens the 'Reset your password' dialog with Email/Phone segmented control, Send verification code, and Back to login (closes). Register: STEP 1 OF 3 purpose pills → purpose-skip → STEP 2 OF 3 email step.

ui_bugs.issue: The Dynopay wordmark on /auth/login and /auth/register has NO data-testid (neither auth-shell-logo nor login-logo/register-logo is present). Reset-password, secure-account and accept-invite all expose data-testid=auth-shell-logo correctly. Add data-testid=login-logo and data-testid=register-logo (or unify on auth-shell-logo) so tests can assert the logo on those two screens.

Spec says the password rules popover should appear on FOCUS of the new-password field, but it only appears after the first keystroke (verified: focus alone shows no MuiPopover/MuiPopper/role=tooltip; typing 'S' immediately shows the 5-line rules). Minor UX/spec deviation.

reset-password-submit becomes ENABLED as soon as both fields have any content, even when 'Passwords don't match' is shown. It disables only until both filled (spec is technically satisfied), but keeping it disabled on active mismatch would prevent a doomed submit.

integration_issues.issue: Spec/review request expects the auth theme to be stored under localStorage/cookie key 'theme-mode-auth', but the implementation writes to 'theme-mode-public' (verified: after clicking theme-toggle-button only theme-mode-public appears in localStorage; theme-mode-auth is never set). Functionally the toggle works and dark bg rgb(11,11,15) is applied via <html data-theme='dark'>, but pre-seeding theme-mode-auth (as the review script does) has no effect. Align on the key name utils/theme/routeContext.ts declares.

issues: Login page title is 'Log in' (sentence case) while the primary CTA on the password step is 'Sign in' — two different verbs for the same action. Consider using 'Sign in' for both or 'Log in' for both to match the 'Go to login' back-links on secure-account & accept-invite.
'Go to login' appears on both secure-account-login-btn and accept-invite-login-btn — consistent sentence case, good.
The forgot-password dialog uses 'Back to login' (consistent with 'Go to login').

action_items: Add data-testid to the login/register header logo (auth-shell-logo or dedicated login-logo / register-logo) so unified auth tests can assert it on all 5 auth screens.

Reconcile the theme storage key: either rename to theme-mode-auth (matching the review-request contract and utils/theme/routeContext.ts) or update the docs to reflect that all surfaces share theme-mode-public.
Trigger the password-rules popover on focus of reset-password-new (not only on first keystroke) to match spec.
Optionally keep reset-password-submit disabled while the confirm field mismatches, to prevent a doomed submit.
Unify login title verb: 'Log in' (title) vs 'Sign in' (button) is inconsistent.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthHeaderControls is correctly rendered on every auth surface and testids are stable and predictable (auth-header-controls, auth-lang-trigger, auth-lang-current, auth-lang-menu, auth-lang-option-<code>, theme-toggle-button). Nice.
AuthShell status pages (secure-account, accept-invite) expose data-status='invalid' declaratively — great for automation.

i18n coverage on auth surfaces is solid: full PT localisation on login heading ('Conecte-se'), reset title ('Defina a nova senha'), trust strip ('taxa', 'liquidação'), and even the theme-toggle aria-label ('Mudar para o modo escuro/claro'). No raw keys observed.

TrustStrip breaks '9' and 'blockchains' onto separate inline elements: innerText is '9\nblockchains' — visually fine but automated text substring checks on '9 blockchains' fail. Consider a single testid on the number+label pair or a data-testid on the whole strip (auth-trust-strip exists — good).
test_credentials: onarrival21@gmail.com (email used only to reach the password step on /auth/login; NOT submitted). No writes performed anywhere.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthShell contract is stable across all 5 auth surfaces except that /auth/login and /auth/register lack a data-testid on the Dynopay wordmark logo — everything else in the review contract (header controls, lang menu with 6 options + persistence, theme toggle + translated label, trust strip, no horizontal overflow at 390/768/1920 in both themes, dark bg rgb(11,11,15), status pages, reset-password fields with mismatch error) is present and passing. Theme storage key is theme-mode-public — do not seed theme-mode-auth expecting it to take effect.
rca of the issue: Login/register logo missing data-testid: the header row on those two pages renders the Dynopay wordmark outside of the AuthShell frame wrapper that ships data-testid=auth-shell-logo. Recommended fix: either move the wordmark into AuthShell (single testid), or add data-testid='login-logo'/'register-logo' directly on the in pages/auth/login.tsx and pages/auth/register.tsx. Theme storage key mismatch: utils/theme/routeContext.ts must be inspected — the review-request contract says 'theme-mode-auth' but observed persistence uses 'theme-mode-public'; align the constant and the cookie/localStorage writes.
